units.rawText: That was me back then... I thought my research could conquer any challenge, and that I could always contribute to the career I loved... But then that disaster came, and in a mere night, I found myself an Exile, trapped in the Cloud.

units.rawText: Let alone my beloved career—survival itself became an urgent problem I had to solve. I forced myself to stay calm and focus on work, repeatedly telling myself not to think about anything else. But whenever I paused, my mind would spiral, wondering if I could ever return to the real world and bring my research results with me.
